name: qoder
label: Qoder CLI
description: Alibaba's Qoder coding agent CLI — one adapter for both the international (qodercli) and China (qoderclicn) builds
tagline: Alibaba's Qoder agent in the terminal, driven headlessly. The international and China builds are separate binaries with separate accounts; the adapter picks the one you are signed in to, or the one QODER_REGION names.

env_config.name: QODER_REGION
env_config.description: Which Qoder build this agent drives. `international` is qodercli (qoder.com / ~/.qoder); `china` is qoderclicn (qoder.com.cn / ~/.qoder-cn). They are separate installs with independent sign-ins, and an account only exists on one of them. Leave blank to use whichever build is signed in, falling back to international.

env_config.name: QODER_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id to run on. Leave empty for the account default.

env_config.name: QODER_REASONING_EFFORT
env_config.description: Reasoning effort for each run. Leave empty for the model's own default.

env_config.name: QODER_MAX_TURNS
env_config.description: Maximum agentic turns per message. Leave empty for the CLI default; a run that hits the limit still returns the answer it reached.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in. Run the edition you want in a terminal and sign in — `qodercli` for the international site or `qoderclicn` for the China site — or install the China build with: npm install -g @qodercn-ai/qoderclicn. A session on one site does not carry over to the other.
